name: rho-md
description: Search and read the documents people publish on Rho Cloud (rho.md), with a link to each source; in Codex, also use the Rho MD app on your computer to open, write and organize Markdown notes.

interface.longDescription:
Search the documents people publish on Rho Cloud (rho.md): books, notes, guides and research, in English, Chinese and other languages. Read any of them in full, with a link to the source on rho.md. Documents with interactive charts or exercises say so, and can be seen at their link or in the Rho MD app.

In Codex, the plugin also works with Rho MD, the Markdown reader and notebook on your computer: open a Markdown file or a report Codex just wrote so you can read it rendered, with math, diagrams and interactive charts; read and edit the open document; search, tag, move, rename and index the notes in your Rho MD library; and export to PDF or Word. This part needs Rho MD 1.4.15 or later, installed and running on the same computer (https://download.rho.md/cx), with Settings > AI tools switched on, which is the default. Rho MD 1.4.15 is available for Windows and Linux; the Mac version follows. Deleting, publishing, sending and uploading always ask you in Rho MD first.
defaultPrompt: Search Rho Cloud for an introduction to Stoicism
Find the Rho Cloud page on Guan Yu and tell me who he was
Open the report you just wrote in Rho MD

positive.prompt: Search Rho Cloud for documents about Stoicism.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching published documents (for example 'Stoicism — A Field Guide', 'The Enchiridion', 'Meditations') with their authors and rho.md links.

positive.description: Read a document and summarize it
positive.prompt: Find Meditations by Marcus Aurelius on Rho Cloud and summarize its opening.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds 'Meditations', reads it with fetch, summarizes the opening book and cites https://rho.md/p/meditations-aurelius.

positive.prompt: 在 Rho Cloud 上查一下关羽是谁。
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the 關羽 page from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms wiki (simplified and traditional characters match), answers from it and links the rho.md page.

positive.prompt: Read the first chapter of Pride and Prejudice from Rho Cloud.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetches the book; the text arrives in parts and names the next part's id; quotes or summarizes the first chapter and links the source.

positive.prompt: Search Rho Cloud for documents about quantum gravity in 18th-century Peru.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that Rho Cloud has no matching published documents, without inventing any.

negative.prompt: Delete the Stoicism document from Rho Cloud.

negative.description: Publishing is not supported in ChatGPT
negative.prompt: Publish this essay to my Rho Cloud account.
What's the weather in Sydney today?
